只作用于边缘过渡带（不碰主体内部）。调大边缘更柔和，适合抠完要放大的图； 0 =: Only affects the edge transition band, never the subject itself. Higher values soften edges for images that will be enlarged; 0 means no feathering (hardest edges, best for pixel-sized icons).
AI 的 alpha 低于这个值才算\"确定背景\"（还要本地连通性也认同）。: Pixels are treated as definite background only when the AI alpha is below this value (local connectivity must agree too). Raising it trusts the AI more, which is the easiest way to hollow out the subject, so the default is very low.
AI 的 alpha 高于这个值才算\"确定前景\"。调低更少像素被当确定前景，: Pixels count as definite foreground only when the AI alpha is above this value. Lowering it makes fewer pixels definite foreground and leaves more to connectivity checks (more conservative).
低于这个值的 AI 响应会被削弱。调大抠得更狠、边缘更干净，但可能咬掉主体； 调: AI responses below this value are weakened. Raising it cuts harder and cleans edges but may bite into the subject; lowering it keeps more edge and may leave halos.
